svg.title: Blueprint BP-02, the ship check scanner. 1 Project folder. 2 Walk the files, skipping .git, node_modules, images, lock files and files over 2 MB. 3 Scan each file: secret keys, public prefixes, the Supabase service role in browser code, code risks such as prices set in the browser and unverified webhooks, the runaway-cost guard, and collecting SQL and Firebase rules. 4 Project checks: database rules, .env in git history, frequent cron jobs, .gitignore. 5 Optional npm audit. 6 Sort worst first and fold repeats. 7 Output to the terminal, JSON or a Markdown or HTML report, with exit codes.
